name: Pylon
one_liner: B2B support platform (usepylon.com) for issues, accounts, contacts and knowledge base with REST API, webhooks and MCP.
auth_notes: Admin-created Bearer API token (scoped tokens listed on pricing page); MCP additionally OAuth 2.0.
access_notes: Pricing page lists REST API, MCP and Webhooks under the Professional seat ($89/seat, annual contract). Free trials are arranged through a sales rep; no self-serve signup seen.

buildability.rationale: Documented API, SDKs and webhooks, but need a paying or sales-arranged trial workspace; tokens are admin-created per customer.

evidence.quote: Pylon offers free trials for prospects. Your sales representative will work with you on setting up the demo organization.
Viewer seats Core support Out-of-the-box Analytics Automations Skills Broadcasts MCP API Integrations
Webhooks](https://docs.usepylon.com/pylon-docs/developer/webhooks.md): Receive webhooks for various events happening in Pylon.

disputes.why: API listed under paid Professional plan; trials only via sales rep.
No self-serve signup; paid plan or sales-arranged trial needed.
API bundled in paid seat plans.
Webhooks docs page exists in official index.
Pricing feature list includes Sandbox Environment (tier unclear).
